gen.title: Complementary angles and right triangle ratios

cards.stem: Which equation shows how sine and cosine relate for complementary angles?
cards.hint: Think about how sine of one acute angle relates to cosine of the other.

cards.stem: Which ratio defines the sine of angle c in a right triangle?
cards.hint: Recall which sides form sine, opposite and hypotenuse.

cards.stem: Which ratio defines the cosine of angle c in a right triangle?
cards.hint: Consider which sides form cosine, adjacent and hypotenuse.

cards.stem: Which ratio defines the tangent of angle c in a right triangle?
cards.hint: Remember tangent uses opposite and adjacent.
